name: Philemon
title: The Hospitable Host
summary: Philemon was a wealthy Christian in Colossae who hosted a house church in his home. He is known through Paul's personal letter, where the apostle appeals to him to welcome back his runaway slave Onesimus, no longer as a slave but as a beloved brother in Christ.

keyEvents.title: Conversion to Christianity
keyEvents.description: Philemon was converted to the faith through Paul's ministry, making him one of the apostle's spiritual children.

keyEvents.title: Host of the House Church
keyEvents.description: Philemon opened his home in Colossae for Christians, and the church gathered there regularly for worship and fellowship.

keyEvents.title: Known for his love and faith
keyEvents.description: Paul commends Philemon for his love toward all the saints and his faith in the Lord Jesus, which has been a source of encouragement to many.

keyEvents.title: Receives Paul's appeal regarding Onesimus
keyEvents.description: Paul wrote a personal letter to Philemon asking him to welcome back his runaway slave Onesimus, now as a Christian brother.

keyEvents.title: Prepares a guest room for Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul expressed hope of being released from prison and asked Philemon to prepare a guest room for him.
